topic: Stephen Miller named chief of staff

framings.label: Neutral personnel announcement
framings.description: Straight news reports state that Trump named Stephen Miller chief of staff to replace Susie Wiles, with little added interpretation.

framings.label: Reaction to midterm losses
framings.description: Posts tie the staffing change to Republican midterm defeats, presenting it as Trump's first major move after the election, sometimes with language like 'fires', 'blowout' or 'wipeout'.

framings.label: Alarm about Miller's influence
framings.description: Coverage quotes a former Trump aide calling the prospect of Miller replacing Wiles 'terrifying', framing the change as a source of concern.

framings.label: Promotion and profile of Miller
framings.description: Pieces present the move as a promotion or explain who Miller is, including biographical angles such as his Duke background.
